## Analysis

The key findings are:
- **Lower facial asymmetry only** (left side) with **sparing of the upper face** (frontalis and orbicularis oculi fully intact) — this is an **upper motor neuron pattern**
- **Gradual onset** (not sudden)
- **Facial pain/numbness**
- **Chin/jaw pain** (pointing to area)

This combination — progressive UMN-type facial weakness with facial pain — is highly concerning for an **intracranial structural lesion** (e.g., tumor) in the contralateral (right) hemisphere affecting both corticobulbar motor fibers and adjacent sensory pathways.
